note: 0 is not None: a falsy test in place of an is-None test fails here
a string enters the iterable branch, then 'None in str' raises TypeError and the handler falls through to the scalar path; a port with no such exception must special-case str explicitly
load-bearing: two iterables that both contain None compare equal regardless of their other elements
None anywhere in the left iterable orders it first, before any element-wise comparison
None in the right iterable orders it last, so left wins despite 1 < 3
membership must test None, not falsiness: 0 in [0] is true but None in [0] is false
no None: falls through to element-wise comparison
equal prefix, longer sequence sorts last
